author: Sarah Gregory
content: Our toddlers had a wonderful time with the soft play, thank you!  The guy who came to set up was prompt on arrival and collection and was really friendly and helpful, not always what you expect nor receive, so we were very pleased with this. We were all also very impressed with the quality and volume of equipment provided, the photos on your website don't do it justice!  The children (8 excited 2 year olds) were very impressed with their own personal sea life themed soft play too, it kept them entertained for the full 3 hours and there was more then enough to keep them all happy and (importantly) ware them all out!  Thank you - totally recommend!
